event_headline: Fed to inject $7.585 billion into markets amid oil crisis and extreme volatility
topic: Global Economic Stability and Market Volatility

chronology.action: Launched missile attacks targeting UAE and other regional countries, described as unprovoked and terrorist by UAE
Crashed to 20-year low with approximately 25% of market gone
Announced injection of $7,585,000,000 into markets at 9 AM ET before market opening
Inflation jumped to 7.2%, highest in three years
Ordered oil refineries to ignore US sanctions and continue buying Iranian oil
Announced temporary suspension of 'Freedom' project related to ship movement in Strait of Hormuz
Warned all ships crossing Strait of Hormuz without permission, threatening to target them
Thwarted UAE's plan to bypass the Strait of Hormuz
Announced investigation into oil companies for gouging customers on gas prices
Hiked iPad and MacBook prices in Australia by at least 20%, citing AI
Made Iran strike comments that shook markets; Brent crude hit two-week high, travel stocks plunged 3%, energy stocks gained
Cut 2026 world growth forecast to 3% citing Iran war fallout and energy shock
